            elif self.source[self.pos] == ';':

            return None  # EOF

            self.pos += 1
            return self.read_list()
        elif ch == ')':

            return Pair(Symbol('quote'), Pair(datum, NIL))
        elif ch == '"':

        else:

            if self.pos >= len(self.source):
                raise SchemeError("unbalanced (")
            if self.source[self.pos] == ')':
                self.pos += 1

                    result = Pair(elem, result)
